verdict.rationale: PlanetScale is a database platform, not an agent/assistant that itself consumes external MCP servers — its documented MCP integration runs the opposite direction (it ships a hosted MCP server that other agents like Claude/Cursor connect to, per planetscale-docs-19/42/44/45). Acting as an MCP client to plug in third-party tool servers is not a role this kind of product occupies, so the axis does not apply.
